sun.security.krb5

类 KrbAsReqBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.security.krb5.KrbAsReqBuilder

  • public final class KrbAsReqBuilder
extends Object
    A manager class for AS-REQ communications. This class does: 1. Gather information to create AS-REQ 2. Create and send AS-REQ 3. Receive AS-REP and KRB-ERROR (-KRB_ERR_RESPONSE_TOO_BIG) and parse them 4. Emit credentials and secret keys (for JAAS storeKey=true with password) This class does not: 1. Deal with real communications (KdcComm does it, and TGS-REQ) a. Name of KDCs for a realm b. Server availability, timeout, UDP or TCP d. KRB_ERR_RESPONSE_TOO_BIG 2. Stores its own copy of password, this means: a. Do not change/wipe it before Builder finish b. Builder will not wipe it for you With this class: 1. KrbAsReq has only one constructor 2. Krb5LoginModule and Kinit call a single builder 3. Better handling of sensitive info
    从以下版本开始:
    1.7

    • 构造器详细资料

      • KrbAsReqBuilder

        public KrbAsReqBuilder(PrincipalName cname,
                       KeyTab ktab)
                throws KrbException
        Creates a builder to be used by cname with existing keys.
        参数:
        cname - the client of the AS-REQ. Must not be null. Might have no realm, where default realm will be used. This realm will be the target realm for AS-REQ. I believe a client should only get initial TGT from its own realm.
        ktab - must not be null. If empty, might be quite useless. This argument will neither be modified nor stored by the method.
        抛出:
        KrbException

    • 方法详细资料

      • getKeys

        public EncryptionKey[] getKeys(boolean isInitiator)
                        throws KrbException
        Retrieves an array of secret keys for the client. This is used when the client supplies password but need keys to act as an acceptor. For an initiator, it must be called after AS-REQ is performed (state is OK). For an acceptor, it can be called when this KrbAsReqBuilder object is constructed (state is INIT).
        参数:
        isInitiator - if the caller is an initiator
        返回:
        generated keys from password. PA-DATA from server might be used. All "default_tkt_enctypes" keys will be generated, Never null.
        抛出:
        IllegalStateException - if not constructed from a password
        KrbException
